page.head: [?]LARISSIMO VIRO IOANNI DALLÆO.

main_text.p: PRODIIT non ita pridem VIR CLARISSIME Scriptorum Anglo-rum Trias, qui etsi diuersa tractárint [?]umenta, in eo tamen conuenerunt omnes, quod [?]busdam Parentis tui τῷ μακαρίτῃ lucubrationi- aliquod vulnus infligere sint conati ; sed [?]ssu parùm fœlici : Primus eorum Ioannes [?]sonius Presbyter, Vir sanè doctus & in antiquitate Ecclesiasticâ exercitatissimus, S. [?]ctij Epistolarum Vindicias edidit, ad-uersus ea quæ scripserat Pater tuus, ut omni-[?]nanifestum faceret, suppositicias esse quæ [?]ij nomine circumferuntur Epistolas, & [?]issimo Martyre prorsus indignas: Secundus [?]elmus Beveregius Presbyter ipse quoque, hoc litterarum genere non sine laude ver-

page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cut off, so the first letter or two of many lines are missing; these are marked [?]. The printed first word is PRODIIT, with the woodcut P as its initial. The Greek word τῷ μακαρίτῃ is printed in the line and is copied as shown. The top border ornament is not text and is left out. No page number or running head is printed.
